# secret.airat.top

Summary:
Secret is a one-time secret sharing service. A secret is encrypted in the browser with
AES-GCM, the key is placed in the URL fragment, and only the ciphertext is stored. The
server cannot decrypt what it holds. Links expire on a timer and can be limited to a
number of opens, with one open (burn after reading) as the default.

Primary URL:
https://secret.airat.top

Key features:
- Client-side AES-256-GCM encryption; the key never leaves the browser.
- Optional passphrase layered on top of the link key via PBKDF2.
- Expiry from 5 minutes to 30 days, and a view limit from 1 to 10.
- Opening a secret is an explicit action, so link previewers do not consume it.
- The creator can destroy a secret early with a burn token issued once at creation.

Tech stack:
Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1, HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

Privacy:
No accounts. No plaintext, keys, or passphrases reach the server. Expired rows are
deleted on a schedule and are unreadable before then.

Contact:
AiratTop - mail@airat.top
